title: Post-embedding Immunogold in Serial Sections: Volumetric Reconstruction, Segmentation and Quantification of Synapses
content: 3D electron microscopy (3D EM) has changed our perception of the fine structure of brain organization, allowing us to identify new patterns of neuronal connectivity, which can be linked to functional outcomes. Although 3D EM allows the visualization of hundreds of targets in a single image, it is not possible to correlate the reconstructed microcircuits with its neurochemistry. Knowing the sub cellular localization of signaling molecules and their receptors would add a great value to the 3D EM reconstructions. Additionally, the quantification of specific molecules is also important in studies addressing disease models or signal transmission within a given microcircuit.
